'''Constantin Gonciulea''' is an American computer scientist and technology executive recognized for his work in advanced computing, quantum technologies, and financial systems. He serves as the Chief Technology Officer for Advanced Technology at [[Wells Fargo]] and co-authored ''Building Quantum Software with Python''.

==Early life and education==
Gonciulea was born in [[Drobeta-Turnu Severin]], [[Romania]].<ref name=abstract>{{cite web | title=Dissertation PDF (OSU ETD) | website=OhioLINK ETD (PDF) | url=https://etd.ohiolink.edu/acprod/odb_etd/ws/send_file/send?accession=osu1488195154360711&disposition=inline | date=2000 | access-date=2025-11-08 | page=V}}</ref> He studied at the [[University of Bucharest]] and earned a Bachelor of Science degree in 1992. According to a 2015 regional mathematical society magazine, Gonciulea was awarded in several Romanian mathematics competitions in his youth, including the Junior Mathematics Olympiad (OJM), the National Mathematics Olympiad (ONM), the [[Gheorghe Țițeica]] Contest, the GMB Solvers competition, and National Scientific Communications Sessions.<ref name="RMM15">{{cite web | title=Revista de Matematică Mehedințeană nr. 15 | website=S.S.M. România – Filiala Mehedinți | publisher=Societatea de Științe Matematice din România, Filiala Mehedinți | url=https://www.ssmrmh.ro/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/RMM-15-FINAL.pdf | date=2015 | access-date=2025-12-26 | format=PDF
 | language=ro}}</ref> He later moved to the United States to continue his studies at [[The Ohio State University]], where he received a Master of Science in 1999 and a Ph.D. in Mathematics in 2000.<ref name=abstract/> His doctoral dissertation, titled ''Virtual epimorphisms of Coxeter groups onto free groups'', focused on algebra, geometry, and group theory.<ref>{{cite web | title=Virtual epimorphisms of Coxeter groups onto free groups | website=Ohio Department of Higher Education | url=https://rave.ohiolink.edu/etdc/view?acc_num=osu1488195154360711 | date=2000 | access-date=2025-11-08}}</ref>

==Career==
After finishing his academic studies, Gonciulea entered the technology sector, specializing in applied computer science and technology leadership. He has worked in the financial services industry on enterprise software and digital banking systems for server-side, web, and mobile platforms.<ref>{{cite web | first=Penny | last=Crosman | date=2024-09-25 | title=Quantum leap: JPMorgan Chase, Wells Fargo push ahead while most banks lag | website=American Banker | url=https://www.americanbanker.com/news/quantum-leap-jpmorgan-chase-wells-fargo-push-ahead-while-most-banks-lag | access-date=2025-11-08}}</ref> His career includes software engineering, technology architecture, and strategy in areas such as payment systems, digital platforms, [[distributed computing]], and financial technology.

At [[JPMorgan Chase]], Gonciulea looked into the potential use of quantum computing in financial services.<ref name=eFC/> His work at the bank involved studying quantum algorithms for various applications, risk analysis, portfolio optimization, and cryptography.<ref name=eFC/>

In June 2021, Gonciulea joined [[Wells Fargo]] to lead the bank’s Advanced Technology organization.<ref name=eFC>{{cite web | title=JPMorgan quantum computing professional who worked at the bank's New York office has left | website=eFinancialCareers | url=https://www.efinancialcareers.com/news/2021/05/quantum-computing-jpmorgan | date=2021-05-04 | first=Sarah | last=Butcher | access-date=2025-11-08}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | title=JPMorgan's quantum computing guy joins hip new team | website=eFinancialCareers | first=Sarah | last=Butcher | url=https://www.efinancialcareers.com/news/2021/06/constantin-gonciulea-jpmorgan-wells-fargo | date=2021-06-24 | access-date=2025-11-08}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | title=Constantin Gonciulea | website=Simon & Schuster (Author page) | url=https://www.simonandschuster.com/authors/Constantin-Gonciulea/238284194 | date=2025-06-01 | access-date=2025-11-08}}</ref> As [[Chief Technology Officer]] for Advanced Technology, he manages research and development in quantum computing, distributed systems, and other [[emerging technologies]].<ref>{{cite web | title=Constantin Gonciulea leaves JPMorgan to head Advanced Technology group at Wells Fargo | website=Inside Quantum Technology | access-date=2025-11-08}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | title=Hype around quantum computing recedes over lack of practical uses | website=Financial Times | technology events, such as the [[QC Ware#Q2B conference|Q2B quantum computing conference]], where he presented his research and long-term technological direction.<ref>{{cite web | title=Q2B 2022 ==Research==
Gonciulea’s research covers algorithmic and software-engineering aspects of quantum computing, with emphasis on optimization, simulation, and applications to financial engineering. He co-authored ''Building Quantum Software with Python: A Developer’s Guide'' with Charlee Stefanski, published by [[Manning Publications|Manning]] in 2025.<ref>{{cite web | title=Building Quantum Software in Python | website=Simon & Schuster | url=https://www.simonandschuster.com/books/Building-Quantum-Software-in-Python/Constantin-Gonciulea/9781633437630 | date=2025-05-27 | access-date=2025-11-08 | isbn=9781633437630}}</ref> He has discussed quantum computing in public forums, including the [[QuEra Computing Inc.|QuEra]] podcast, The Quantum Insider, and Superposition Guys.<ref>{{cite web | title=Superposition Guy's Podcast — Building Quantum Software with Constantin Gonciulea and Charlee Stefanski | website=Quantum Insider | url=https://thequantuminsider.com/2024/09/28/superposition-guys-podcast-building-quantum-software-with-constantin-gonciulea-and-charlee-stefanski/ | date=2024-09-28 | access-date=2025-11-08 |first=Yuval |last=Boger}}</ref>

In July 2025, he delivered an [[Association for Computing Machinery|ACM]] Learning TechTalk introducing key concepts in quantum computing for software developers.<ref>{{cite web | title=An Elementary Approach to Quantum Computing with Charlee Stefanski and Constantin Gonciulea | url=https://learning.acm.org/techtalks/elementarycomputing | date=2025-07-17 | access-date=2025-12-24 | website=Association for Computing Machinery}}</ref> His publications include work on quantum algorithms and their applications to financial engineering, 
including ''A generalized quantum inner product and applications to financial engineering''. 
His works ''Challenges and opportunities in quantum optimization'' and ''Designing a fast and flexible quantum state simulator'' introduced Spinoza, an open-source [[Rust (programming language)|Rust]]-based quantum state simulator with [[Python (programming language)|Python]] bindings.<ref>{{cite web | title=Designing a Fast and Flexible Quantum State Simulator | url=https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.01493 | date=2023-03-02 | access-date=2025-12-24 | website=[[Cornell University]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | title=Constantin Gonciulea — Google Scholar | website=Google Scholar | url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=en&user=Gu3R01cAAAAJ | access-date=2025-11-08}}</ref> Gonciulea is also listed as an inventor on patents related to distributed quantum computing and quantum visualization.<ref>{{cite web | title=Patents by Inventor Constantin Gonciulea | website=Justia Patents | url=https://patents.justia.com/inventor/constantin-gonciulea | date=2021-05-12 | access-date=2025-11-08}}</ref>

His publications address the following topics:
* Building blocks for state preparation and distribution encodings (including [[normal distributions]]). 
* Hash-based generalization of a quantum inner-product approach for weighted sums of [[Discrete mathematics|discrete functions]] (<span style="font-size:80%"><math>\sum_{k=0}^{N-1} w_k,f(k)</math></span>), enabling restricted evaluations (e.g., [[Value at risk|VaR]]) and comparator-style quantities.
* Oracle construction for [[Grover's algorithm|Grover Adaptive Search]] on constrained binary optimization with near-term resource constraints in mind. 
* Automatic oracle generation using a Quantum Dictionary pattern with conditional additions of [[Polynomial|polynomial coefficients]]. 
* Demonstration on portfolio optimization, using both simulation and real hardware results. 
* Spinoza simulator implementation choices and internal representation details.
* [[Python (programming language)|Python]]-facing [[API]] via [[Rust (programming language)|Rust]] bindings circuit-style interface.

==Selected publications==
* Building Quantum Software with Python. Charlee Stefansky, Constantin Gonciulea. Manning Publications. Shelter Island NY. 2024. {{ISBN|9781633437630}}
* Designing a Fast and Flexible Quantum State Simulator. Saveliy Yusufov, Charlee Stefanski, Constantin Gonciulea. arXiv. arXiv:2303.01493. Ithaca NY. 2023.
* Quantum Combinatorial Optimization in the NISQ Era. Austin Gilliam, Stefan Woerner, Constantin Gonciulea. ACM Computing Surveys. Vol. 55. New York NY. 2023.
* A Generalized Quantum Inner Product and Applications to Financial Engineering. Vanio Markov, Charlee Stefanski, Abhijit Rao, Constantin Gonciulea. arXiv. arXiv:2201.09845. Ithaca NY. 2022.
* Properties of the Discrete Sinc Quantum State and Applications to Measurement Interpolation. Charlee Stefanski, Vanio Markov, Constantin Gonciulea. arXiv. arXiv:2207.00564. Ithaca NY. 2022.
* Efficient Quantum State Preparation for Monte Carlo Integration. Austin Gilliam, Constantin Gonciulea. arXiv. arXiv:2107.10235. Ithaca NY. 2021.
* Quantum Algorithms for Financial Applications. Marco Pistoia, Constantin Gonciulea, Abhijit Rao. arXiv. arXiv:2105.02868. Ithaca NY. 2021.
* Grover Adaptive Search for Constrained Polynomial Binary Optimization. Austin Gilliam, Stefan Woerner, Constantin Gonciulea. Quantum Journal. Vol. 5 Article 428. Switzerland. 2021.
* On the Structure of Quantum Amplitude Amplification. Austin Gilliam, Constantin Gonciulea. arXiv. arXiv:2009.03736. Ithaca NY. 2020.
* Optimizing Quantum Search Using a Generalized Version of Grover’s Algorithm. Austin Gilliam, Marco Pistoia, Constantin Gonciulea. arXiv. arXiv:2005.06468. Ithaca NY. 2020.
* Foundational Patterns for Efficient Quantum Computing. Constantin Gonciulea, Marco Pistoia, Austin Gilliam. arXiv. arXiv:1907.11513. Ithaca NY. 2019.
